about: A cited VF-20 guide price (or face value where the guide lists no circulated price) for each of the 890 dated FILLED album holes. Not yet used by the app: the album total on the Hall is still the ledger board figure ($2,059.39, collection/board.json, authoritative per the owner). Sum of these rows $733.61. 17 Silver Eagle rows (A025, A026) were priced at face under the project's own rule and carry claude_note: they are bullion and are worth at least melt.
